spec_basis: docs/roadmap.md §2 (GC 合入 gate — this file is its executable form)

frozen_reference_set.note: Binary fingerprints and suite per-case hashes live in reports/evidence/BASE-G0/manifest.json. If gc/tracing advances past the frozen candidate commit before GC-GAP runs, the reference set MUST be re-frozen (manifest version bump) before any official sample; measuring a stale candidate is not permitted.
frozen_reference_set.diagnostic_arm: zjs gc/tracing 62061f94, -Dzjs_gc=rc — separates the branch's non-collector deltas from the collector switch; diagnostic only, never a gate input

gap_measurement.consumer: GC-GAP (official RC vs tracing account; input to G1-GC)

workloads.full_suite: bench_v8 Octane 2.0 v9, zlib skip contract per tools/perf/bench_v8/README.md

per_benchmark_account_rows: pause distribution (run-level p50/p95/p99/max, cumulative STW) + collection counts (minor/major)

primary_safety.statistic: paired log-ratio, run-level, per-benchmark and suite geomean
primary_safety.rule: one-sided 95% non-inferiority lower confidence bound >= frozen margin
primary_safety.margin_rule: The margin is an owner decision taken at G1-GC (throughput triangle, process ledger §20.2a: renegotiate memory envelope / promote parallel marking / tiered criteria). It MUST be written into this file (policy_version bump) before the first n=8 look of G2-GC-MERGE; changing it after any look invalidates the sequence.
primary_safety.basis: doc (roadmap §2; ledger §20.2a defers the number to post-GC-GAP owner ruling)

primary_benefit.rule: exactly one preregistered benefit metric per merge candidate, named in the candidate's evidence manifest before the first look (e.g. major pause p99, or cumulative STW p99); all other metrics are descriptive or multiplicity-corrected

pause_statistics.rule: aggregate within each run first (p50/p95/p99/max/cumulative STW); compare run-level statistics only; individual GC events are never independent samples (pseudo-replication)

looks.inconclusive_rule: still crossing the margin at n=32 = INCONCLUSIVE: no merge, branch retained; reopen only after a substantive mechanism or measurement-environment change

sequential_control.note: a preregistered confidence-sequence procedure may replace this if implemented and frozen before the first look
sequential_control.basis: proposed (roadmap §2 requires a frozen alpha-spending/confidence-sequence scheme but does not fix one)

activation_canary.rule: Per-workload minimum mechanism coverage. Thresholds are derived, not hand-picked: for each GC-heavy workload, minimum_major_cycles_per_sample, minimum marked/allocated bytes, minimum swept bytes, and minimum gc_active_time_share are frozen at 0.5x the values recorded by the candidate arm in the GC-GAP evidence manifest, automatically, when that manifest lands. A gate sample failing any canary row is invalid (not a pass, not a fail).
categorical_requirements: each GC-heavy workload independently triggers at least one major collection per sample
collector mode and policy digest identical across all samples
growth factor identical across measurement/test/release configurations
measurement, test, and release configurations run the same collector code (no builtin.is_test divergence)
activation_canary.basis: doc (roadmap §2 canary list); derivation constant 0.5x is proposed

verdicts.pass: safety bound holds and preregistered benefit metric improves; proceeds to VM-CONTRACT-GC
verdicts.fail: safety bound violated at any look under the spending scheme
verdicts.inconclusive: n=32 exhausted while crossing the margin; no merge, branch retained

measurement_contract.additional: docs/perf/README.md sampling discipline; official reads: orphan-process and affinity check first; pinned big-core cluster; ABBA interleaving
